WITH pricier_films AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    rental_duration,
    rental_rate / replacement_cost AS rate_cost_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
),
per_rating_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration,
    AVG(rate_cost_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM pricier_films
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT 
  rating,
  avg_duration,
  avg_ratio
FROM per_rating_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  NULL,
  AVG(avg_duration),
  AVG(avg_ratio)
FROM per_rating_stats
